A complete modern English translation of this identical work was published by Springer in 1988–89 (John D. Blanton, 2 vols., reviewed in Mathematical Gazette). Blanton translated from the Latin original; our item is the German edition — same work, different source language. Per the contract rule, a complete modern English from any source language yields not_first.
